result:
A failed text message can no longer stop an item from being finished, and the organiser can now turn texts off and on per venue. The type-check passes with your exact command. I haven't run the service or written any tests, so none of this has been exercised yet.

**Registering:** the existing code never sent a text on registration, so I left that path alone. Texts are only sent when an item is finished and when a part ships; both now go through the new handling.

**Failed messages:** the first attempt gets a 5-second timeout, so a hung TextLoop can't stall the door. That hang was the one way the old code could still block. If the attempt fails, it is retried every 10 minutes until 2 hours after the first attempt. Nothing in this path can throw back into the request, so the item is saved and returned either way. `smsSent` still tells you whether the first attempt went through.

**Turning texts off:**
- `PUT /venues/:venue/sms` with `{"enabled": false}` turns texts off for that venue, and `{"enabled": true}` turns them back on. `GET /venues/:venue/sms` shows the current setting.
- Texts are on by default, and venue names are matched case-insensitively.
- While texts are off, the message goes to a per-venue list instead of being sent. The volunteers' screen can read it from `GET /venues/:venue/door-messages`.
- If texts are switched off while a retry is waiting, that message moves to the door list instead.

**What to know before Saturday:**
- **No authentication:** the new switch endpoints have none, because the service has no organiser role. Anyone who can reach the service can flip the switch.
- **Restarts:** the switch, the door list and the pending retries are all held in memory, as the rest of the service's data already is. A restart clears them, and pending retries are lost.
- **Constructor change:** `RepairCafeService` now takes a required `VenueSmsStore` argument (placed before `log`), and `src/config/main.ts` is updated to pass it. Anything else that builds the service, such as tests, will need the same change.

The changes are in `src/application/repair-cafe-service.ts`, `src/application/ports.ts`, `src/adapters/inbound/http-server.ts`, `src/adapters/outbound/in-memory-repositories.ts` and `src/config/main.ts`.
